steps.text: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, peanut butter and maple syrup together in a bowl until no dry streaks remain.
Divide between two jars, cover, and chill overnight so the oats soften into a thick, spoonable porridge.

Stir in the oats and corn and cook at a lazy bubble, stirring now and then, until the oats are tender and the pot thickens.
Sweeten with the maple syrup, spoon into bowls and scatter fresh blueberries over the top.

Melt 2 tbsp of the butter and fold it through the batter.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-low, add a pat of the remaining butter, and pour the batter in 4-inch rounds. Dot each pancake with blueberries.
Cook until the edges look set and bubbles hold their shape across the surface, then flip once and cook until the centres register 160 °F on an instant-read thermometer.
